text: APPROVE. The extracted helper moves the label, bracket and trailing-operator checks over verbatim with identical null-return conditions, and the caller keeps the same `open`/`close` values. That removes about six complexity points for one added, so the method lands well under 15, and the nullable tuple plus `var (open, close) = bounds.Value;` should compile without warnings. I could only review the diff, not build it, so I'm assuming the unseen rest of the method doesn't use the removed `at` or `after` locals.
